meta.name: trend-discovery
meta.description: Use when the user wants to discover trending social topics, hashtags, sounds, posts, reels, shorts, creators, or formats in a niche. Searches public trend and discovery endpoints, ranks evidence, and turns trends into practical content angles.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发现热门社交趋势，快速提炼内容选题。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果做内容创作却常为选题发愁。
copy.tagline_en: Discover trending social topics and turn them into content ideas.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a content creator looking for timely social media ideas.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude会搜索TikTok、Instagram、YouTube等平台的公开趋势数据,把证据按强度排序,整理成一份包含内容角度的趋势简报,并给出可做的内容点子。
howto.when: 当你说出想了解某个领域的热门话题、标签、声音等,或要求做趋势简报时触发。

say.text: 查一下TikTok上最火的背景音乐
say.note: 会拉取热门歌曲列表并整理成趋势简报

say.text: 帮我看看健身领域最近有什么热门标签
say.note: 会搜索相关标签并给出内容建议

say.text: 我想做一份美妆方向的每周趋势简报
say.note: 会从多个平台收集数据生成简报

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude searches public trend data on platforms like TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube, ranks evidence by strength, and produces a trend brief with content angles and actionable ideas.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to discover trending topics, hashtags, sounds, or other trends in a niche, or request a trend brief.

say_en.text: Check the most popular background sounds on TikTok
say_en.note: Fetches popular song lists and turns them into a trend brief

say_en.text: Find trending hashtags in the fitness niche
say_en.note: Searches relevant hashtags and suggests content angles

say_en.text: Make me a weekly trend brief for beauty
say_en.note: Collects data from multiple platforms and generates a brief
